name: Open wound
description: A cut that has not closed. It stiffens in the morning and makes every load heavier.
remedyNote: Rest will close it slowly; a healer will close it sooner.
onset: The cut begins to pull when you move, and the skin around it is hot.
daily: The wound is no easier to carry than it was yesterday.
recovery: The edges have closed cleanly enough; the ache is only a memory of the knife.

provenance.notes: A narrative consequence of a road accident, not a wound-location simulation.
